reasoning_content: Now re-run the server. Let's use the `check` command first maybe. But note `check` may also init backend. Let's try running server again.

action.command:
cd /workspace/src/Bovis.Web && export DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 && nohup dotnet run --no-build -- server > /tmp/bovis_run2.log 2>&1 &
echo "pid $!"; sleep 35; echo "=== tail ==="; tail -25 /tmp/bovis_run2.log; echo "=== port ==="; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep 18080
